бывать.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

meanings.en: to happen, to exist, there can be
meanings.note: 3rd person бывает = there is / can be

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.

examples.text: У мужчины, мальчик, бывает не только жена. Это моя девушка.
examples.trans: A man, my boy, can have more than just a wife. She's my girlfriend.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

выпить.gloss: to drink (up); to have a drink

meanings.en: to drink up, to have a drink of

examples.trans: May I drink a tiny drop of beer?

examples.text: Милый, можно я выпью капельку пива?
examples.trans: Darling, may I drink a tiny drop of beer?

related.gloss: to go on a drinking binge

выручить.gloss: to help out, rescue, bail out

meanings.en: to help out, rescue, come to aid of

examples.trans: A friend will always help out in trouble.

examples.text: Спасибо, друг, ты меня очень выручишь!
examples.trans: Thank you, friend, you will really help me out!
You saved me. That was quick thinking.

meanings.note: substantivized adjective, declines like an adjective

examples.trans: It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

examples.text: Всё отлично, отдыхай! Сегодня выходные, всё круто!
examples.trans: Everything is great, get some rest! It is the weekend today, everything is cool!

examples.text: У мужчины, мальчик, бывает не только жена. Это моя девушка.
examples.trans: A man, my boy, can have more than just a wife. She's my girlfriend.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

examples.text: Но вечером я обещал быть с женой.
examples.trans: But I promised to be with my wife this evening.

examples.text: Позвони мне вечером. Договоримся на завтра.
examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: To run for a second term.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Красивая. Но это же не ваша жена! Я вашу жену видел.
examples.trans: She's pretty. But that's not your wife! I've seen your wife.
I love our town very much.
You're in love with another man's wife!

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Это небольшой комплимент от нашего заведения.
examples.trans: This is a small gift from our establishment.

examples.text: Мы живём в небольшом тихом городе.
examples.trans: We live in a small, quiet town.

examples.text: Извините, у нас тут небольшой бардак.
examples.trans: Excuse us, we have a bit of a mess here.

examples.text: Мы даём вам ещё немного времени.
examples.trans: We are giving you a little more time.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.trans: Don't laugh. Read me the number.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that?
Don't worry, everything will be fine.

examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that? Samsonov is finished, he buried himself.

examples.text: Миша, скоро у нас модный показ.
examples.trans: Misha, soon we will have a fashion show.

examples.text: Показ будет прямо у нас в отеле?
examples.trans: Will the show be right here in our hotel?

examples.text: Отлично, я приеду за день до показа.
examples.trans: Excellent, I will arrive a day before the show.

examples.text: Экскаваторщик — это не мой уровень. Может, поможешь?
examples.trans: Excavator driver isn't my level. Maybe you could help?

постоять.gloss: to stand for a while; to wait

examples.trans: I'll stand here for a bit.
I know the problems of ordinary people.
Do you think that's really possible?
It's realistic to do that in a day.

examples.text: Я не шучу и реально сваливаю отсюда.
examples.trans: I am not joking and am seriously getting out of here.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: свободен! = you're dismissed (a boss to an employee)

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
